result.summary: PASS. Independently re-read docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-033.md (not TEST-DESIGNER's handoff summary). All 9 ACs covered: AC1-5 and AC9 each have a new scripted psql/live-DB case; AC6/AC7 point at the existing automated apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.test.ts; AC8 has a grep-based confirmation. No TODO or vague judgment-call language found (grep -in TODO on the spec: zero matches). Every DB-level case (AC1-5, AC9) names an exact psql command, exact expected output/error text (including constraint names), and an explicit failure condition -- none require a judgment call. Cross-checked the spec's factual claims against the real artefacts rather than trusting them: (1) read apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts -- confirmed it uses node:crypto randomBytes (never Math.random), alphabet is exactly the stated 32-char string, length 26, unbiased byte%32 mapping; read inviteCode.test.ts -- confirmed its 5 tests genuinely assert AC6 (10000-code zero-collision, line 36-42; runtime Math.random-spy check, line 44-59) and AC7 (1000-code alphabet-membership, line 27-34; exact alphabet-string assertion, line 17-25), not tautological stand-ins. (2) Read apps/bot/drizzle/0007_sturdy_network.sql directly -- its columns/types/nullability/defaults, three ON DELETE restrict FKs, and invite_codes_code_unique index match AC1's expected \d+ output exactly, and its command-tag order matches the spec's stated sequence. Confirmed registrations.invite_code_id (nullable uuid) and registrations.source (text NOT NULL) already exist from migration 0001, making the AC4 insert statement valid. Migration count/order (0000-0007, 8 files) matches the spec's shared-setup assumption. (3) Ran every AC7/AC8 grep from the spec against docs/agents/design/REQ-033.md and every AC9 grep against the migration file -- all resolved exactly as the spec predicts (matches found where expected, zero matches/exit 1 for the forbidden-column grep). The AC6/AC7-to-automated-test and AC8-to-grep split is legitimate, not a shortcut: the pointed-to tests and design content genuinely exist and genuinely assert what the ACs require.
